about_the_game:
SHIKA-Q is an ultrafast competitive puzzle game where victory is decided in an instant by connecting Links on a 10×10 board.

The battlefield evolves in real time as attacks, disruption, recovery, and special moves unfold simultaneously.
There’s no time to hesitate—every moment demands your next move, creating relentless tension and speed.

Unlike traditional falling-block puzzle games, blocks in SHIKA-Q do not drop from above.
The moment you place a block, the board comes alive. Because matches play out in real time, success isn’t just about forming Links—it’s about reading your opponent and choosing the right action at the right moment, creating a mind game closer to a fighting game than a classic puzzle.

Every decision directly affects the outcome. Players must rely on both strategic thinking and fast reflexes.
Momentum can shift in seconds, and the state of the match is instantly readable, making SHIKA-Q not only thrilling to play but also exciting to watch—highly compatible with esports-style competition.

Music That Fights With You

SHIKA-Q’s most distinctive feature is its Music, fully synchronized with the match itself.

This is more than background music.
Vocal tracks dynamically intertwine with gameplay, directly amplifying tension and excitement as the battle unfolds.
Gameplay, music, and emotion sync together to create an immersive experience unlike anything else.

_____________________________________

Game Features

■ Strategy × Super Speed × Showdown (1–2 Players)

Connect Links on a 10×10 board as offense and defense unfold in real time.
Built around an ultrafast competitive design, split-second decisions determine victory or defeat.

Custom settings allow you to fine-tune the balance between speed and strategy—from more deliberate, tactical matches to extreme high-speed battles—supporting a wide range of playstyles.

In addition to Offline Versus, SHIKA-Q is planned to support Online Matches and Ranked Play, where a single moment can decide the outcome against players from around the world.

■ Challenge Mode (Single Player)

A solo mode fully synchronized with music and global leaderboards.
As you progress, both the music and gameplay evolve, demanding careful health management and strategic offense and defense.

Clear all 99 stages and aim for the highest score.

Unlike Versus Mode, Challenge Mode offers a different experience focused on discovering optimal solutions, delivering a deeply satisfying puzzle challenge.

■ Characters, Worldbuilding, and Customization

A cast of unique characters brings their own themes and flair to every match.

Customize your experience with UI designs, music, emotes, loading screens, wallpapers, icons, and more—express yourself even during battle.

Each theme includes dedicated character songs, allowing you to explore each character’s personality and world through music.

Rebuild the atmosphere to match your playstyle and preferences, and enjoy battles in a space that feels uniquely yours.

■ DLC Battle Pass – A Continuously Expanding Online Experience

The DLC Battle Pass unlocks rewards progressively by completing missions.

Packed with premium content—UI designs, music, emotes, loading screens, wallpapers, icons, and more—it elevates the competitive experience to the next level.

The more you play, the more expressive and visually rich your experience becomes.
Your progress is visible, your effort rewarded, supporting a long-term online journey filled with growth and achievement.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported

short_description: SHIKA-Q is an online, real-time puzzle battle on a 10×10 board, where players link blocks to attack and defend. Original vocal tracks drive the action, creating an immersive experience that makes music a core part of gameplay.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Dutch, Turkish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Polish, Traditional Chinese
